button

Buttons are used to trigger an action.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
size String default No Button size.
type String default No Button type.
plain Boolean false No Whether the button is hollow with transparent background.
disabled Boolean false No Disabled or not.
loading Boolean false No Whether the loading icon is displayed before the name.
form-type String No Used in the form component to trigger the submit/reset event.
hover-class String button-hover No Style class of the tapped state. When hover-class is set to none, no style is available.
hover-stop-propagation Boolean false No Whether to prevent the ancestor node from being tapped.
hover-start-time Number 20 No Tapping duration before the tapped state is displayed, in milliseconds.
hover-stay-time Number 70 No Retention time of the tapped state after the button is released, in milliseconds.

Valid Values of size

Value Description
default Default size.
mini Small size.

Valid Values of type

Value Description
primary Green.
default White.
warn Red.

Valid Values of form-type

Value Description
submit Submits the form.
reset Resets the form.

Sample Code

1. Default Button (Normal & Disabled)

<view class="btn-group">
  <button type="default" hover-start-time="200" hover-stay-time="500">Normal Default</button>
  <button type="default" disabled="true">Default Disabled</button>
</view>
Page({ data: {} });
.btn-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

2. Warn Button (Normal & Disabled)

<view class="btn-group">
  <button type="warn">Warn Action</button>
  <button type="warn" disabled="true">Warn Disabled</button>
</view>
Page({ data: {} });
.btn-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

3. Primary Button & Form Actions

<view class="btn-group">
  <button type="primary" bindtap="handlePrimaryTap">Primary Button</button>
  <button type="primary" size="mini" style="align-self: flex-start;">Mini Primary</button>
</view>
Page({
  handlePrimaryTap() { ma.showToast({ title: 'Tapped Primary', icon: 'success' }); }
});
.btn-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

Bug & Tip

  1. The default value of button-hover is {background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); opacity: 0.7;}.
  2. Currently, the button with the form-typeattribute is available only for the form in the current component. Therefore, if the button is encapsulated in the customized component and the form is outside the customized component, the form-type attribute of the button becomes invalid.
